---
title: "Events"
output-file: events.html
---

Full catalogue of social and political events used to explain trend changes across the
studies. Every event has a primary source (or is flagged as secondary-sourced until
confirmed). Filter by type, scope, theme, or period.

```{ojs}
events = FileAttachment("events.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof typeFilter = Inputs.select(
  ["All", ...new Set(events.map((d) => d.type))],
  { label: "Type" }
)
viewof scopeFilter = Inputs.select(
  ["All", "PT", "EU", "World"],
  { label: "Scope" }
)
viewof topicFilter = Inputs.select(
  ["All", ...new Set(events.flatMap((d) => (d.topics || "").split(";").map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)))],
  { label: "Theme" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
filteredEvents = events.filter((d) => {
  if (typeFilter !== "All" && d.type !== typeFilter) return false;
  if (scopeFilter !== "All" && d.scope !== scopeFilter) return false;
  if (topicFilter !== "All" && !(d.topics || "").split(";").map((t) => t.trim()).includes(topicFilter)) return false;
  return true;
})

Inputs.table(filteredEvents, {
  columns: ["start_date", "scope", "type", "titulo_en", "primary_source_url", "verified"],
  header: {
    start_date: "Date",
    scope: "Scope",
    type: "Type",
    titulo_en: "Title",
    primary_source_url: "Primary source",
    verified: "Verified",
  },
})
```
